# ONEKNIGHT

> Websites, automation, analytics, advertising and SEO/GEO for Ukrainian businesses, by Ivan.
> ONEKNIGHT is also a product in development: one system for a business's website, orders, reviews, modules and notifications.
> The public site shows an interactive ONEKNIGHT demo. All numbers in that demo are made up and labelled as demo data.

## Services

- Websites: business card site, service website, online store, corporate website. Custom-built, not templates.
- Automation of repetitive business processes.
- Analytics: traffic sources, customer behaviour, conversion.
- Advertising: strategy, creative, launch, audit, optimisation, scaling.
- SEO, GEO and preparation for AI search.

## Prices (starting prices; the exact price depends on the task)

- Business card site: from 7,000 UAH
- Service website: from 12,000 UAH
- Online store: from 14,000 UAH
- Corporate website: from 15,000 UAH
- ONEKNIGHT: 149 UAH/month. Website customers get the first 3 months free, including up to 5 paid modules.
- ONEKNIGHT module: 99 UAH/month
- Technical support: 1,000 UAH/month, response target within 48 hours.

## Work

- Karpatu.shop (https://karpatu.shop): online store for handmade wooden bread boxes. Custom build (React + Node.js), 5 languages, structured data, llms.txt.
